records.subject: proposed monthly common charge
records.quote: Budget 2025: proposed monthly common charge of $235 per unit from March 1, 2025.

records.subject: heat pump policy
records.quote: Heat pump policy.

records.subject: adoption of bylaws and house rules
records.value: Bylaws and house rules adopted by unit owners
records.quote: Adopted by the unit owners on May 1, 2019. Effective May 1, 2019.

records.subject: board composition and quorum
records.value: Board of three directors (President, Treasurer, Secretary); quorum is two
records.quote: The Association is governed by a board of three directors: a President, a Treasurer and a Secretary. A quorum is two directors.

records.subject: who sets the monthly charge
records.value: Board sets monthly common charges in the annual budget
records.quote: Monthly common charges are set by the board in the annual budget and take effect on the date the board states.

records.subject: bylaw amendment threshold
records.value: Two-thirds vote of unit owners at an annual meeting
records.quote: These Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at an annual meeting.

records.subject: house rule amendment threshold
records.quote: The House Rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board.

records.subject: number of pets
records.quote: Each unit may keep one (1) pet.

records.subject: dog weight limit
records.quote: Dogs may not exceed 35 pounds.

records.subject: pet registration
records.value: All pets must be registered with management
records.quote: All pets must be registered with management.

records.subject: permitted work hours
records.quote: Renovation and construction work is permitted Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

records.subject: weekend and holiday work
records.quote: No work is permitted on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays.

records.subject: quiet hours
records.quote: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night.

records.subject: fixtures on balconies
records.value: No fixtures, appliances or equipment without written board approval
records.quote: No fixtures, appliances or equipment may be mounted on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval.

records.subject: barbecues and open flames
records.quote: Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies.

records.subject: minimum lease term
records.quote: Units may not be leased for a term of less than six (6) months.

records.subject: assigned spaces
records.quote: Each unit has one assigned space.

records.subject: guest parking limit
records.quote: Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 72 hours.

records.subject: pool hours
records.quote: The pool is open 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily during the season, June 1 to September 15.

records.subject: landscaping non-renewal notice sent
records.quote: Please accept this message as written notice that Harbor View Condominium Association will not renew the Landscaping Services Agreement that ends on March 31, 2026.
